ITEM 1 | Pale cream-white florets clustered in a loose mound on the left-center of the plate, with slightly yellowish tinges and a soft, slightly moist look; florets are bumpy, roughly 1–3 cm across, with some small stems visible; mound covers about 25% of the plate and stands about 2–3 cm high; no visible browning or sauce, sitting directly on the white plate | 110

ITEM 2 | Single small pale cream floret piece detached from the mound, about 1.5 cm across, located just below and right of the main mound, same soft pale color and texture | 8

ITEM 3 | Scattered tiny crumbs or fragments of the same pale cream-white material, each under 0.5 cm, sitting on the right side of the plate | 2

ITEM 4 | Small bright green fleck, about 0.5 cm long, flat and thin, lying near the bottom-center of the plate, looks like a leaf fragment or herb bit with a slightly darker edge | 0.5
